description: This file defines the VerifiedResourcesService class, which manages verification processes for emails and phone numbers, including requesting verification codes and validating them, using repositories and external libraries.

classes.name: VerifiedResourcesService
classes.description: Service class handling verification of emails and phone numbers, including requesting verification codes and verifying them.

methods.name: requestEmailVerificationCode
methods.description: Requests an email verification code to be sent to the user, handling success and error cases.

methods.name: requestPhoneVerificationCode
methods.description: Requests a phone verification code to be sent, handling errors if sending fails.

methods.name: verifyPhone
methods.description: Verifies a phone number with a code, returning verified resource info or throwing an error.

methods.name: verifyEmail
methods.description: Verifies an email with a code, returning verified email info or throwing an error.

methods.name: getUserVerifiedEmailById
methods.description: Retrieves a user's verified email by ID.

methods.name: getTeamVerifiedEmailById
methods.description: Retrieves a team's verified email by ID.

methods.name: getVerifiedEmail
methods.description: Retrieves a user's verified email by email address.

methods.name: getUserVerifiedEmails
methods.description: Retrieves a list of verified emails for a user.

methods.name: getTeamVerifiedEmails
methods.description: Retrieves a list of verified emails for a team.

methods.name: getUserVerifiedPhoneNumberById
methods.description: Retrieves a user's verified phone number by ID.

methods.name: getTeamVerifiedPhoneNumberById
methods.description: Retrieves a team's verified phone number by ID.

methods.name: getUserVerifiedPhoneNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a user's verified phone number by number.

methods.name: getTeamVerifiedPhoneNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a team's verified phone number by number.

methods.name: getUserVerifiedPhoneNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of verified phone numbers for a user.

methods.name: getTeamVerifiedPhoneNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of verified phone numbers for a team.
